metadata.title: Hindu Temple Travel Catalogue
metadata.coverage: Curated international catalogue; not an exhaustive census of Hindu temples.
metadata.null_policy: null means unknown or not verified; never interpret as false, free, closed, or zero.
metadata.map_policy: Google Maps links are name-and-locality searches, not verified Place IDs, ratings or entrance coordinates.
metadata.media_policy: Display author, source link, license link and changes alongside every photo. Some photos still require visual identity review.
metadata.source_policy: Primary excerpts corroborate selected facts. Encyclopedia retrieval does not verify every claim. Current arrangements require rechecking.

collections.name: 12 Jyotirlingas
collections.notes: A widely followed twelve-shrine selection. Vaidyanath, Nageshwar and Bhimashankar have alternative regional identifications; this is not a ruling on those traditions.

collections.name: Char Dham of India
collections.notes: Badrinath, Dwarka, Puri and Rameswaram. Distinct from the four Uttarakhand shrines.

collections.name: Uttarakhand Char Dham
collections.notes: Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath; annual opening dates and registration require current confirmation.

collections.name: Panch Kedar
collections.notes: Five Himalayan Shiva shrines; collection order is not a driving itinerary.

collections.name: Ashtavinayaka
collections.notes: Eight Ganapati shrines of Maharashtra. Traditional pilgrimage returns to Morgaon.

collections.name: Six Abodes of Murugan
collections.notes: The six traditional Murugan pilgrimage temples in Tamil Nadu.

collections.name: Pancha Bhoota Shiva Temples
collections.notes: Five temples associated with earth, water, fire, air and space.

items.name: Badrinath Temple
items.summary: Vishnu worship on the Alaknanda river in the Garhwal Himalayas; the mountain shrine has a seasonal pilgrimage calendar.

items.name: Kedarnath Temple
items.summary: A high Himalayan Shiva shrine reached through the Kedarnath valley; weather and the annual opening season shape every visit.

items.name: Gangotri Temple
items.summary: A river-goddess pilgrimage on the Bhagirathi, distinct from the glacier trek to Gaumukh.

items.name: Yamunotri Temple
items.summary: A mountain shrine to Yamuna approached from the Janki Chatti side, with hot springs near the temple.

items.name: Tungnath Temple
items.summary: The Panch Kedar shrine above Chopta combines a stone temple with a steep mountain walking approach.

items.name: Rudranath Temple
items.summary: Shiva is venerated in his face form at this remote Panch Kedar shrine reached on foot.

items.name: Madhyamaheshwar Temple
items.summary: This Panch Kedar shrine is associated with Shiva's navel and stands in a high mountain valley.

items.name: Kalpeshwar Temple
items.summary: A cave-associated Panch Kedar shrine where Shiva's matted hair is revered.

items.name: Jageshwar Temples
items.summary: A cluster of stone shrines set among deodar trees in the Kumaon hills.

items.name: Neelkanth Mahadev Temple
items.summary: A forested hill shrine associated in tradition with Shiva drinking poison during the churning of the ocean.

items.name: Mansa Devi Temple, Haridwar
items.summary: A hilltop goddess shrine overlooking Haridwar; distinguish it from the Mansa Devi temple in Panchkula.

items.name: Chandi Devi Temple, Haridwar
items.summary: A goddess shrine on Neel Parvat, forming part of Haridwar's hill-temple pilgrimage.

items.name: Dhari Devi Temple
items.summary: A riverside goddess shrine on the Alaknanda between Srinagar and Rudraprayag.

items.name: Gopinath Temple, Gopeshwar
items.summary: A Shiva temple in Gopeshwar known for its stone architecture and large trident in the courtyard.

items.name: Vaishno Devi Temple
items.summary: A cave shrine in the Trikuta hills approached from Katra through a managed pilgrimage route.

items.name: Amarnath Cave Temple
items.summary: A high-altitude cave pilgrimage associated with a naturally forming ice lingam and a limited annual yatra season.

items.name: Shankaracharya Temple
items.summary: A hilltop Shiva temple above Srinagar with a stepped approach and views over the city.

items.name: Raghunath Temple, Jammu
items.summary: A temple complex in Jammu centred on Rama and associated with Dogra royal patronage.

items.name: Kheer Bhawani Temple
items.summary: A Kashmiri goddess shrine built around a sacred spring at Tulmulla.

items.name: Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Temple
items.summary: Ayodhya's Ram Lalla shrine is a principal focus of devotion to Rama; visitor arrangements should be checked with the trust.

items.name: Hanuman Garhi, Ayodhya
items.summary: A prominent Hanuman shrine with a stepped approach in the centre of Ayodhya.

items.name: Kanak Bhawan
items.summary: A palace-style temple devoted to Rama and Sita in Ayodhya's sacred centre.

items.name: Shri Kashi Vishwanath Temple
items.summary: The Vishwanath lingam anchors Shiva worship in Kashi, close to the Ganga and the old city's lanes.

items.name: Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple
items.summary: A Hanuman shrine associated with Tulsidas and a long-standing tradition of devotional music.

items.name: Durga Kund Temple
items.summary: A red-coloured Durga temple beside the Durga Kund tank in southern Varanasi.

items.name: Annapurna Devi Temple
items.summary: A shrine to Annapurna, the goddess of nourishment, near Kashi Vishwanath.

items.name: Kaal Bhairav Temple, Varanasi
items.summary: Bhairava is revered here as the guardian of Kashi in the city's living pilgrimage tradition.

items.name: Krishna Janmasthan Temple Complex
items.summary: Mathura's temple complex commemorates Krishna's birthplace in Hindu tradition.

items.name: Banke Bihari Temple
items.summary: A major Braj shrine where Banke Bihari is worshipped through distinctive darshan and seva traditions.

items.name: Prem Mandir
items.summary: A marble temple complex whose reliefs and garden displays narrate episodes from Krishna and Rama traditions.

items.name: Radha Raman Temple
items.summary: A Gaudiya Vaishnava shrine associated with Gopala Bhatta Goswami and the Radha Raman deity.

items.name: ISKCON Krishna Balaram Mandir
items.summary: An ISKCON pilgrimage centre in Raman Reti devoted to Krishna and Balarama.

items.name: Vindhyavasini Temple
items.summary: A major goddess shrine in Vindhyachal, linked with the area's three-temple pilgrimage tradition.

items.name: Gorakhnath Temple
items.summary: A Nath monastic and temple centre associated with the yogi Gorakhnath.

items.name: Brahma Temple, Pushkar
items.summary: A prominent Brahma shrine near Pushkar Lake, central to the town's pilgrimage landscape.

items.name: Karni Mata Temple
items.summary: A temple to Karni Mata distinguished by its protected resident rats and the reverence shown to them.

items.name: Khatu Shyam Temple
items.summary: Devotion centres on Shyam, identified with Barbarika in a Mahabharata-linked tradition and associated with Krishna's blessing.

items.name: Salasar Balaji Temple
items.summary: A Hanuman pilgrimage centre in Salasar where Balaji is represented with a beard and moustache.

items.name: Mehandipur Balaji Temple
items.summary: A Hanuman shrine with distinctive local ritual traditions; observe the temple's current visitor guidance respectfully.

items.name: Shrinathji Temple
items.summary: A Pushtimarg haveli temple with darshan organised around the daily seva of Shrinathji.

items.name: Govind Dev Ji Temple
items.summary: A Radha-Krishna shrine within Jaipur's royal precinct, closely tied to the city's devotional life.

items.name: Eklingji Temple
items.summary: A Mewar temple complex dedicated to Eklingji, a form of Shiva associated with the region's rulers.

items.name: Jwala Ji Temple
items.summary: The goddess is worshipped through natural flames rather than a conventional central idol.

items.name: Chintpurni Temple
items.summary: A major hill-region goddess pilgrimage in the Una area.

items.name: Naina Devi Temple, Bilaspur
items.summary: A hilltop goddess shrine above the plains near the Punjab-Himachal border.

items.name: Chamunda Devi Temple
items.summary: A goddess temple near the Baner river in the Kangra region.

items.name: Bajreshwari Devi Temple
items.summary: A historic goddess shrine in Kangra associated with the region's Shakti pilgrimage tradition.

items.name: Baijnath Temple
items.summary: A stone Shiva temple noted for its medieval Nagara architecture and inscriptions.

items.name: Jakhu Temple
items.summary: A Hanuman shrine on Jakhu hill above Shimla, identifiable by its large Hanuman statue.

items.name: Bhimakali Temple
items.summary: A multi-storeyed Himalayan temple known for its timber-and-stone architectural character.

items.name: Mata Mansa Devi Temple, Panchkula
items.summary: A major Shakti shrine at the foot of the Shivalik hills near Chandigarh.

items.name: Sthaneshwar Mahadev Temple
items.summary: A Shiva shrine associated with the sacred landscape of Kurukshetra.

items.name: Durgiana Temple
items.summary: A Hindu temple complex set beside a sacred tank in Amritsar.

items.name: Swaminarayan Akshardham, Delhi
items.summary: A carved-stone Swaminarayan complex combining a mandir with cultural exhibitions and landscaped grounds.

items.name: Chhatarpur Temple
items.summary: A large temple complex at Chhatarpur centred on Katyayani, a form of the goddess.

items.name: Kalkaji Temple
items.summary: A long-established Kali shrine in south Delhi with a prominent Navratri pilgrimage tradition.

items.name: Somnath Temple
items.summary: A coastal Jyotirlinga shrine at Prabhas Patan with a long history of reconstruction and worship.

items.name: Nageshwar Jyotirlinga

items.name: Dwarkadhish Temple

items.name: Ambaji Temple

items.name: Kalika Mata Temple, Pavagadh

items.name: Ranchhodraiji Temple, Dakor
items.summary: A Krishna shrine at Dakor where the deity is worshipped as Ranchhodrai.

items.name: Modhera Sun Temple

items.name: Kashtabhanjan Hanuman Temple
items.summary: A prominent Hanuman shrine within the Swaminarayan devotional tradition.

items.name: Siddhivinayak Temple, Mumbai

items.name: Dagadusheth Halwai Ganapati Temple

items.name: Trimbakeshwar Temple

items.name: Bhimashankar Temple

items.name: Grishneshwar Temple

items.name: Mahalakshmi Temple, Kolhapur
items.summary: The Ambabai shrine anchors Kolhapur's goddess pilgrimage and temple-town identity.

items.name: Tulja Bhavani Temple
items.summary: A major Bhavani shrine with longstanding importance in Maharashtra's devotional and royal traditions.

items.name: Saptashrungi Temple
items.summary: A mountain goddess shrine in the Nashik region, set among the Saptashrungi hills.

items.name: Vitthal Rukmini Temple
items.summary: The principal Varkari pilgrimage shrine, devoted to Vitthal and Rukmini on the Chandrabhaga river.

items.name: Shirdi Sai Baba Temple

items.name: Mayureshwar Temple, Morgaon

items.name: Vighneshwar Temple, Ozar

items.name: Mahaganapati Temple, Ranjangaon

items.name: Mahakaleshwar Temple

items.name: Sharada Devi Temple, Maihar

items.name: Baidyanath Temple, Deoghar

items.name: Chhinnamasta Temple, Rajrappa

items.name: Vishnupad Temple

items.name: Mahavir Mandir, Patna

items.name: Mundeshwari Temple

items.name: Mukteshwar Temple, Bhubaneswar

items.name: Biraja Temple

items.name: Dakshineswar Kali Temple

items.name: Tarapith Temple
